gist: も marks that the same comment applies to another topic: "X too / also X." It takes the topic slot — use 私も学生です, not ×私はも学生です. After someone says 私は学生です, answer with 私も… to add yourself to that group.

formation.note: も replaces は; do not stack them (×私はも / ×私もは). Do not put も after the predicate noun (×私は学生もです → 私も学生です). も does not replace の: 私の友達も… keeps の.

explanation: は introduces or focuses the topic; も says "that description is true of this noun as well." So after 田中さんは先生です, 山田さんも先生です means Yamada is a teacher too. Because も already marks the topic-like slot, stacking は is ungrammatical: ×私はも学生です → 私も学生です. Putting も on the wrong noun is another trap: ×私は学生もです → 私も学生です. Keep earlier patterns: です/だ for the copula, か for questions, の for noun links (私の友達も学生です).

senses.label: Same category, another person
senses.body: Respond to someone's self-introduction by adding yourself with も.
senses.example_ruby: [私|わたし]も[学生|がくせい]です。

senses.label: Also + noun link
senses.body: の still links possession; も marks the whole phrase.
senses.example_ruby: [私|わたし]の[友達|ともだち]も[日本人|にほんじん]です。

senses.label: Both A and B
senses.body: NもNも means both members share the same comment.
senses.example_ruby: [山田|やまだ]さんも[田中|たなか]さんも[学生|がくせい]です。
senses.example_en: Yamada-san and Tanaka-san are both students.

senses.label: Also in a yes/no question
senses.body: Ask whether someone else shares the same category: NもNですか。
senses.example_ruby: [木村|きむら]さんも[会社員|かいしゃいん]ですか。
senses.example_en: Is Kimura-san an office worker too?

register_context: Default polite: NもNです / NもNですか. Plain form: NもNだ (writing, thoughts, later clauses). Spoken casual often drops だ: NもN。 Same です/だ habits as earlier lessons.

mistakes.wrong_ruby: [私|わたし]はも[学生|がくせい]です。
mistakes.right_ruby: [私|わたし]も[学生|がくせい]です。
mistakes.why: も replaces は; stacking はも is ungrammatical.

mistakes.wrong_ruby: [私|わたし]は[学生|がくせい]もです。
mistakes.right_ruby: [私|わたし]も[学生|がくせい]です。
mistakes.why: も marks the topic noun (私も…), not the predicate noun (×学生もです).

mistakes.wrong_ruby: [私|わたし]もは[学生|がくせい]です。
mistakes.right_ruby: [私|わたし]も[学生|がくせい]です。
mistakes.why: Do not put は after も either — only one topic marker.

contrasts.label: は vs も
contrasts.summary: は marks the topic for a new comment; も marks "this one too" and replaces は rather than stacking.
contrasts.ex_a_ruby: [私|わたし]は[学生|がくせい]です。
contrasts.ex_a_en: As for me, I'm a student. (introducing / focusing the topic)
contrasts.ex_b_ruby: [私|わたし]も[学生|がくせい]です。
contrasts.ex_b_en: I'm a student too. (same comment applies to me as well)

contrasts.label: First mention vs "also"
contrasts.summary: Opening with no prior shared category usually takes は; も needs a previous item in the same group (said or obvious).
contrasts.ex_a_ruby: [田中|たなか]さんは[医者|いしゃ]です。
contrasts.ex_a_en: Tanaka-san is a doctor. (setting the topic)
contrasts.ex_b_ruby: [山田|やまだ]さんも[医者|いしゃ]です。
contrasts.ex_b_en: Yamada-san is a doctor too. (adding another member)
